purpose: OWNER 5557988072 item 6 -- declared venue maintenance intervals. An outage whose first error falls inside a declared window is classified scheduled_maintenance (planned venue outage), never an L5 fidelity failure, a collector defect or strategy behaviour. Windows are declared from an owner statement or the venue's own notice; the campaign never infers one from errors.
rules: declared windows are read-only inputs to diagnostics: no gate, cap, admission or policy change depends on them

the recovery sequence after a window is unchanged: account read healthy -> orphan-order reconcile before any mutation -> public prints resume vs the pre-outage baseline (or recorder tape) -> resume the bounded validation

timed-interval evidence is never formed across a window (intervals are only between consecutive unique decisions of one session); decisions time-stamped inside a window are reported as a provenance anomaly, never counted as cadence evidence
windows are appended, never edited after their end

windows.note: start is the first observed 503; the owner declared maintenance until 06:00 ET. Prints after end_utc still have to pass the recovery gate before any session.
